about.intro: "What To Play Today?" is an unofficial fan site that helps you decide what Steam game to play today, whether solo or with friends.
about.whatBody: Pick 4 things — how many are playing (1 to 6+), today's mood (laughs, scary, brainy, chill), how much time you have, and your budget — and get 5 matching games. It exists to solve "there are too many games to choose from." If you'd rather browse yourself, there's a checkbox-filterable list for that too.
about.dataBody: Games are collected automatically from the official Steam API, and only included if they meet a quality bar of 300+ reviews and a 75%+ positive rating. This surfaces well-regarded mid-size and indie titles, not just the most famous names.
about.contactBody: For feedback or corrections, please use the form below.
about.contactUnavailable: A contact form is coming soon.

privacy.intro: This page explains how "What To Play Today?" ("this site") handles user information.
privacy.cookieBody: This site uses a cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) to remember your preferred display language, plus analytics cookies from Google Analytics (see below).
privacy.analyticsBody: This site uses Google Analytics, which uses cookies to collect usage data (pages viewed, time on site, general location, etc.). This data is collected anonymously and does not identify you personally. See Google's Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy) for how Google handles this data. You can stop collection by disabling cookies in your browser settings.
privacy.adsBody: This site may use third-party advertising, including Google. These vendors may use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this site or other sites. You can opt out of personalized advertising at Google Ads Settings (https://adssettings.google.com/).
privacy.dataBody: This site has no account system and does not collect names, email addresses, or other personal information.
privacy.contactBody: For questions about this policy, please use the form below.
privacy.contactUnavailable: A contact form is coming soon.

terms.intro: By using "What To Play Today?" ("this site"), you agree to the following terms.
terms.disclaimerBody: Game information on this site (price, player count, estimated session length, etc.) comes from the official Steam API or from estimates made by the site operator. Accuracy and freshness are not guaranteed — always check the Steam store page before purchasing or playing.
terms.unofficialBody: This site is an unofficial fan project with no affiliation to Valve Corporation or the rights holders of any game listed. Game titles and images belong to their respective owners.
terms.liabilityBody: The operator is not liable for any damages arising from the use of this site.
terms.changesBody: These terms may be changed without prior notice.
